integrity.catalecticant_basis: The essential-variable dimension equals the rank of the first catalecticant, proved directly from the kernel of directional differentiation.
integrity.euler_basis: A separating one-parameter subgroup reduces Euler characteristic to a count of monomials by support size.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: arXiv:math/0601452 is Algebraic Geometry and lists MSC 14Q15 among its classes.
integrity.subspace_basis: The archival source defines tensor subspace varieties and their Grassmannian-bundle desingularization; the symmetric one-factor specialization is defined directly in the result.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to degree at least three; the quadratic symmetric-determinantal specialization is excluded.
Exact essential-dimension strata use compactly supported Euler characteristic.
The result treats one symmetric factor, not general partially symmetric tensor products.
Euler characteristic is coarse; zero Euler characteristic does not imply emptiness or simple topology.
title: Euler characteristics of the essential-variable filtration of homogeneous forms
